This chapter demonstrates the same Quarto source-to-publication contract with R. The rendered Markdown and figure remain stable inputs for Jekyll and the manual PDF builder.

## A reproducible R figure

The figure is generated from the built-in `cars` dataset, so the fixture does not require network access or external data.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-stopping-distance
#| fig-cap: "Speed and stopping distance in the cars dataset"
#| fig-alt: "A scatter plot showing stopping distance increasing with speed"

plot(
  cars$speed,
  cars$dist,
  pch = 19,
  col = "#35b779",
  xlab = "Speed",
  ylab = "Stopping distance"
)
grid(col = "grey85")
```

The generated artifacts can be reviewed without requiring R during an ordinary site build.
